scope: No physical robot command is authorized. A zero numeric array is not a generic robot hold/stop command.
ordered_lifecycle: Use a fresh real module with no rights; exact command and telemetry opens must be denied without native effects.
Use a separate fresh explicitly configured simulator module, never a hardware driver endpoint.
Decode and compare an actual complete native telemetry value before any command.
The controller releases one model-specific hold step; encode the entire real command once without automatic replay.
The independent actual simulator peer verifies the requested hold semantics and complete telemetry.
The controller releases one model-specific stop step; encode the actual documented stop command once.
Observe the independent terminal state, close every owner and preserve actual report/log/product/source pins.
failure_rules: A timeout is not permission to resend a command; preserve the unknown native outcome.
No default wildcard grant, vendor-name authority, raw robot IP or Native debug/update route.
A simulator PASS cannot be promoted to physical robot or vendor official-suite PASS.
Missing message variants, controller major, QoS, leases or device requirements remain explicit gaps.
